$description: Theme-invariant typography: font families + the display scale + tracking. Fonts loaded via the single Google Fonts <link> in index.html. The scale exists so sections stop inventing their own clamp(): text-* tokens are emitted into Tailwind's --text-* namespace (utilities text-display/text-h1/...) and tracking-* into --tracking-*. Line-heights stay utilities on purpose.

font-display.$description: Headings only. Variable serif with a real 100-900 weight range and an optical-size axis: headings are bolded in 5 places, so a single-weight display serif would render synthetic bold.

font-mono.$description: Terminal / CLI / technical labels / window titles.

text-display.$description: One hero moment per page (hero h1, contact h2). Calibrated to the inherited render: 48px <640, 60px @640, 72px >=768 (9.375vw reaches the 4.5rem cap exactly at 768). Never in UI.

text-h1.$description: Section headlines (projects/education h2). Calibrated: 36px mobile, 60px from 768 up (7.8125vw reaches the cap exactly at 768); between 640-768 it interpolates 50-60px where the old utility sat at 48.

text-h2.$description: Sub-headlines (about h2). Calibrated: 30px mobile, 48px from 768 up; interpolates 40-48px in the 640-768 band where the old utility sat at 36.

text-h3.$description: Card titles at a fixed 20px (the size the text-xl they consumed rendered).

text-label.$description: Uppercase tracked micro-labels (the text-xs they rendered before the token).

tracking-display.$description: Display-size headings; also the h1-h6 base rule (was a -0.04em literal in index.css).

tracking-heading.$description: Section h2 tracking; calibrated to the tracking-tighter the section headlines actually rendered (-0.02em was the phase-1 aspiration, discarded because it moved the render).

tracking-label.$description: Wide uppercase labels; calibrated to the tracking-[0.3em] they rendered before the token (0.24em was the phase-1 aspiration, discarded because it moved the render).
